historicalEngineOnly: WebView2; accepted 561 PASS. No feature PASS transferred to CEF.

rows.design: Existing Python authorities/effect classifications/exact binding stay unchanged; CEF host must not import them or issue authority.
CEF CreateBrowser + RequestContext + lifecycle callbacks; host-owned handles, one session per owner, max3, Job-owned tree, no autonomous popup.
Bounded fixed host DOM/CDP instrumentation, leaf-before-aggregation redaction; current Application projection/DTOs reusable; CEF-native secret capture needs own implementation.
Host-owned binding table session/page/navigation/context/observation versions + exact node/fingerprint, no heuristic rebind or public backend ID.
Closed typed commands mapped to host fixed primitives; before-dispatch revalidation, STARTED/UNKNOWN/no retry semantics retained.
Owned native window exposes page-only human interaction; no debug/browser UI escape; epoch increment/invalidation and pause/resume remain Python contracts.

Host-native volatile monotonic registry, bounded policy, schema-aware and leaf redaction; terminal authorities SUBMIT_CONFIRMED/TAKEOVER_END_CHECKPOINT only, destroyed unconfirmed lineage denies resume.
OnFileDialog or fixed private CDP binding assigns host-selected file only after exact approval/identity/epoch/digest revalidation; no path/model selectors.

OnBeforeDownload/OnDownloadUpdated callbacks exist; Chrome-style defaults must be overridden and pre-file-effect cancel ordering proved. Keep FILE_DOWNLOAD and existing staging contracts, no auto-open/ingestion.
Explicit CEF root_cache_path/cache_path, no ambient/default user profile. Incognito still writes installation state under root; singleton/relaunch cannot cross-owner reuse.
Browser close/CEF shutdown != confirmed process/Job/profile deletion. Verify controller, NetworkService/renderer/utility exit, private roots and retained staging owners.
Native source dispatcher + platform sinks deny all with registered-handler canaries/popups/takeover. WebView2 Block03 PASS not transferable.
Native suite must independently prove each gate plus broker PUBLIC_ONLY; profile/port availability remains UNKNOWN.

Concepts and private closed framing/ownership reusable; .NET host executable and engine-specific transport messages cannot be assumed CEF binary-compatible. Future Infrastructure implementation needs adapter bridge.
rows.note: Reuse is contractual, not executable binary compatibility; future CEF Infrastructure bridge requires its own implementation and integration verification.

notProven: CEF download callback versus first filesystem effect ordering
note: Unproven native integration is not proof of an architectural gap; no new capability is enabled.
